title: Creaking Eye
body:
**It's so boring! Everything is Ender — Ender Pearls, Ender Eyes...**  
But why isn't there a *Creaking Eye*?

**Gucksim:** "So let's add it!"

This vanilla-style **Resource Pack** replaces the default **Eye of Ender** texture with a brand new **Creaking Eye**!  
Perfect for players who want a subtle, lore-friendly change to spice up their Minecraft experience.

---

✅ **Features:**
- Custom texture for the Eye of Ender  
- Vanilla-friendly style  
- Lightweight and simple
